scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason: The confirmation page lacks the coffee and shipping breakdown required by the pending checkpoint.
scenarios.diagnosis: The confirmation page shows that the order is in and that €17.90 was charged, but the test was configured to require additional price-detail text on that page.
scenarios.suggestion: Update the confirmation checkpoint to verify the order-confirmed message and the €17.90 total, or explicitly make a coffee and shipping breakdown a product requirement before testing for it.

Added House Espresso and Paper Filters to the bag as requested.

Pressed the plus button next to Paper Filters once; shipping updated to Free and the total updated to €51.00.

scenarios.name: Promo code total
scenarios.reason: The lowercase code was applied once, but the bag reports “That code doesn't work” and total remains €91.00.
scenarios.diagnosis: The promo-code check treated the required lowercase code as invalid even though it was entered and applied exactly once.
scenarios.suggestion: Fix promo validation so the required lowercase code welcome10 is accepted for this bag and applies the €9.10 discount.
